messages:
Maya (CS): FYI AtlasHealth hit repeated 500s on Dedicated when resuming long chat sessions. Customer says it started after switching to 8-bit quantization and long context windows. They included a repro below.

Sam (Eng Intake): Thanks Maya — can you paste the exact curl, model name, pool id, and a trace/request id? Also what's the customer severity and ARR?

Maya (CS): Repro curl (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","deployment":"dp-34","input":"<very long conversation>"}'
```
Response: 500 with body `{\"error\":\"internal_server_error\"}`
Logs (snippet):
```
runtime.go:453: panic: kvcache: index out of range
stack: .../serving/kv_cache.go:212
request_id=atlas-2026-03-18-31 trace_id=trc_0a1b2c3d
```

Jordan (Eng-ML): Initial guess: KV cache boundary or cache reuse bug when session tokens >2048. Which runtime binary and quant build were they on? Also what's batch_size?

Maya (CS): Customer provided env: deployment dp-34 (Dedicated), runtime v2.7.1, quant=8bit, batch_size=1. Trace id above is `trc_0a1b2c3d`. It's intermittent but reproducible if conversation length > ~2300 tokens.

Lila (Sales): AtlasHealth is mid-market, ~120k ARR, renewal in 6 weeks. They'll expect a timely fix or credits. Please escalate priority where appropriate.

Evan (Product PM): Proposed acceptance criteria for prioritization: (1) Reproduce in staging with dp-34 config, (2) Root cause identified, (3) Regression test added to CI to prevent reintroduction, (4) Canary deploy to Dedicated with fallback, (5) No perf regression >5% for common request sizes.

Sam (Eng Intake): Creating an engineering issue and assigning to eng-runtime. Can someone confirm priority P1 vs P2? Given renewal risk, leaning P1.

Jordan (Eng-ML): I'll take point on investigation. Requesting core/heap and full trace. Also want the exact protobuf payload and KV cache metrics. If it's an overflow we'll need a patch and regression harness.

Maya (CS): Support case opened: SC-8932. Attached core dump, full logs, and the exact payload used by the customer. Core path: /var/dp-34/cores/core.atlas.trc_0a1b2c3d.

DeployBot: New issue created: INF-4829 by Jordan (link: https://redwood.internal/issues/INF-4829)

Jordan (Eng-ML): Triage notes added to INF-4829: repro confirmed on staging with same runtime/quant, failure triggered by cache index calc when session length > 2048. Next steps: add bounds check, reproduce in unit test (simulate kv length > 4096), run perf runs, plan canary. ETA: initial fix proposal in 24h.

Evan (Product PM): Sounds good. Scope negotiation: aim to include small invariant check + unit test in first patch. If fix requires deeper refactor, schedule follow-up with a targeted canary and rollback. Launch criteria = successful canary for 48 hours with no 5xx spike.

Lila (Sales): Please keep me cc'd on customer comms. If we can get a patch within 72 hours that's ideal for renewal conversation.

Maya (CS): Will update AtlasHealth and share timeline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng Intake): Assigned INF-4829 to eng-runtime, priority P1. Adding to Product backlog board under \"Dedicated stability\".

Jordan (Eng-ML): Beginning debug now, will post logs and a minimal repro branch.

Maya (CS): Noted — will monitor and escalate if customer reports regressions.
